parandCommute.scenarioNote: 35–50 km one-way reported; 100 km/day round trip used as transparent scenario

rentBurden.note: Maximum rent share of income conventionally ~30%

nationalCommute.note: Thought-experiment scenario, not observed national commuting fuel. Each year the one-way home-to-work distance grows by the selected km (per side); round-trip daily extra = 2 × selected km × years since 1400; extra fuel/day = 24.822m workers × round-trip extra km × 9 L/100km, added to the 1400 baseline (88 M L/day).

covidDipNote.note: 1399 decline is a COVID mobility shock, not housing evidence
